statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client MAY include the Accept header in the request to list the description formats that it understands.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST respond with a description of the requested resource and return the description in the message body of the response, if the DESCRIBE method request can be successfully fulfilled.
actions: send response with description of requested resource
include description in message body of response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The DESCRIBE response SHOULD contain all media initialization information for the resource(s) that it describes.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Servers SHOULD NOT use the DESCRIBE response as a means of media indirection by having the description point at another server; instead, using the 3rr responses is RECOMMENDED.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If a client obtains a valid description from an alternate source, the client MAY use this description for initialization purposes without issuing a DESCRIBE request for the same media.
actions: use alternate description for media initialization
skip issuing DESCRIBE request for the same media

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client should use any MTag to either validate the presentation description or make the session establishment conditional on being valid.
actions: use MTag to validate presentation description
or make session establishment conditional on description validity

statements.subject: server
statements.description: It is RECOMMENDED that minimal servers support the DESCRIBE method, and highly recommended that minimal clients support the ability to act as "helper applications" that accept a media initialization file from a user interface, or other means that are appropriate to the operating environment of the clients.
